newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cricket-South Africa win toss, bat first v India.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-South Africa win toss, bat first v India.

text.p: South Africa batted first after winning the toss in the second test against India on Thursday. South Africa lead the three-test series 1-0.
South Africa - Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Brian McMillan, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Lance Klusener, Allan Donald, Paul Adams.
India - Woorkeri Raman, Nayan Mongia, Rahul Dravid, Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Mohammed Azharuddin, V.V.S. Laxman, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad, D. Ganesh.
